Algeria Télécoms lance un centre de comp: Algeria Télécoms launches a digital skills center in Saïda
ALGER, 21/06/2026 (Algeria Tech) — Alger: ALGIERS, 06/21/2026 (Algeria Tech) — Algeria Télécoms has completed, in record time, the transformation of an abandoned building into a large-scale digital skills center in Saïda. Officially inaugurated on June 14, 2026, the facility is part of the national strategy to support young people toward digital professions. This project, the result of a collaboration between Algeria Télécoms and local authorities, aims to democratize access to free training in digital skills.
Le centre de Saïda, le plus grand du gen: The Saïda center, the largest of its kind in Algeria, offers training modules covering emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, web development, and data science. The sessions, delivered by industry experts, are open to all young people in the wilaya, with no diploma requirement. According to project officials, over 5,000 registrations have already been recorded since its opening.
Ce projet s’inscrit dans le cadre du pla: This project is part of the "Digital Algeria 2030" plan, which aims to train one million young people in digital professions by 2030. The wilaya of Saïda, known for its economic dynamism, thus becomes a model in terms of educational innovation. Local authorities praised the initiative, highlighting its role in reducing youth unemployment and adapting skills to the needs of the labor market.
Algeria Télécoms, acteur clé du secteur: Algeria Télécoms, a key player in Algeria's telecommunications sector, has invested over 150 million dinars in the renovation and equipping of the center. The facilities include high-tech laboratories, connected training rooms, and collaborative spaces. The company has also established a partnership with several local businesses to facilitate the professional integration of graduates.
Une cérémonie d’inauguration officielle,: An official inauguration ceremony, attended by regional authorities and representatives from the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications, marked the launch of the center. Speeches were delivered to emphasize the importance of this project in combating the digital divide and promoting social inclusion.
En Algérie, le secteur des télécommunica: In Algeria, the telecommunications and digital sector is experiencing sustained growth, with an internet penetration rate exceeding 60% in 2026. The Algerian government has launched several initiatives to accelerate the digital transition, including the "Digital Algeria 2030" program. This plan provides for the creation of 1,000 competency centers across the country, with an overall budget of 200 billion dinars. The wilaya of Saïda, located in western Algeria, is one of the first to benefit from this system, confirming its position as an economic and technological hub.
